layouts.name: Music City Grand Prix
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The series 2021 course construction description and 2022 track details identify the complete 11-turn Nashville street circuit, retaining both opposite bridge carriageways, the stadium-side quadrilateral and Southwestern three-corner return. The pinned historical circuit relation supplies a complete independently joined 3466.5 m route through its exact street and raceway members. Pit roles and current stadium redevelopment are excluded. The 3378 m catalogue scalar and 2.17-mile operator description remain separate; temporary barriers, carriageway centerline placement and historical fine corner alignment remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3466.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
